# ContexAi Academy

> Online technology courses that run from complete beginner to professional AI engineering, AI governance, quantum computing, automation and robotics. Every course states what you will be able to do and assesses it — coding courses by automated tests, others by marked written work. Lessons are narrated. Completion earns a ContexAi Academy Certificate of Completion; the Academy does not currently hold external accreditation.

- [Where to start](https://contexai.org/academy/start/): a five-question guide to the right first course

## Fees

- Study plan: $10 a month for any 2 courses at a time, at any level. Each extra plan adds 2 more courses.
- New students: Free in your first month, then $10 a month for any 2 courses.
- Leaving your courses stops further charges.

## Beginner Pathway in Technology

Start from zero. Use generative AI at work without being misled by it, then write your first Python with an AI assistant as a tutor rather than a ghostwriter. Leads into the Foundation Certificate in Applied AI.

- [B1 AI at Work: A Practical Introduction for Non-Programmers](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/b1-ai-at-work/): What generative AI actually does, where it fails, and how to use it at work without being misled by it. No coding. You leave able to decide what may go into…
- [B2 Python from Zero, with AI as Your Assistant](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/b2-python-from-zero/): Write your first real Python: values and types, decisions, lists and dictionaries, and reading errors. Use an AI assistant the way a good student uses a tutor…

## Foundation Certificate in Applied AI

Characterise an AI problem, implement a simple learning system, and evaluate it without fooling yourself. The entry point to the ladder.

- [F1 How Intelligent Systems Behave](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/f1-how-intelligent-systems-behave/): Before you build anything, learn to characterise the problem. This course gives you the vocabulary that every later decision depends on: what an agent is…
- [F2 Search, State Spaces and Why Symbolic Methods Survive](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/f2-search-and-state-spaces/): Search is the oldest idea in AI and the one most often written off as obsolete. It is not: planning loops, constraint solving and verifier-based reasoning are…
- [F3 Your First Learning System](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/f3-your-first-learning-system/): Build a working supervised model and — more importantly — learn to measure it in a way that will not embarrass you later. The evaluation discipline taught…
- [F4 Working with Data: Cleaning, Encoding and Leakage](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/f4-working-with-data/): The work that consumes most of a real project and appears in almost no course: missing values, encoding, imbalance and provenance. CS2023 added this to the…

## Professional Certificate in AI Engineering

Build, evaluate and deploy a grounded AI application within a defended cost and latency budget.

- [E1 Deep Learning Architectures and Transformers](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/e1-deep-learning-and-transformers/): How the architecture behind every current language model actually works — attention, tokenisation, embeddings — at the level where you can reason about cost…
- [E2 Evaluation Engineering](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/e2-evaluation-engineering/): The discipline that separates a working AI system from a demo. Most curricula treat evaluation as a subsection of machine learning; here it is a course…
- [E3 Retrieval, Grounding and Attribution](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/e3-retrieval-grounding-attribution/): Retrieval past the naive stage: chunking as a decision with consequences, hybrid dense and sparse search, reranking, and attribution you can verify. Naive…
- [E4 Serving, Quantisation and Cost](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/e4-serving-quantisation-and-cost/): Latency, cost and energy are requirements, not afterthoughts. Quantisation, caching, batching and the arithmetic of what a workload actually costs before you…
- [E5 Capstone: A Graded, Evaluated AI Product](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/e5-capstone-evaluated-ai-product/): Build one thing properly, end to end, and defend it. The capstone is assessed on evidence — your evaluation report and your cost model — not on whether the…

## Advanced Certificate in Agentic Systems

Design, secure and evaluate autonomous multi-agent systems, and write the safety case for them.

- [A1 Agent Architectures: Planning, Tools and Memory](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/a1-agent-architectures/): An agent is a loop with a budget. This course is about what goes in the loop, what stops it, and the failure modes — goal drift, loop divergence, premature…
- [A2 Multi-Agent Orchestration and Protocols](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/a2-multi-agent-orchestration/): MCP, A2A and the protocol layer; when multiple agents genuinely help and when they are an expensive way to add failure modes. Includes the question most teams…
- [A3 Long-Horizon Evaluation](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/a3-long-horizon-evaluation/): Evaluating a trajectory, not an answer. Task-completion time horizons, benchmark contamination and saturation, and why an agent can score well on every step…
- [A4 Adversarial AI: Injection, Exfiltration and Red-Teaming](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/a4-adversarial-ai/): Prompt injection is not a prompt problem; it is a privilege problem. The OWASP LLM Top 10, indirect injection via tool output, exfiltration paths, and…
- [A5 Capstone: An Autonomous System with a Safety Case](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/a5-capstone-autonomous-system/): Build an autonomous system and write the safety case for it: what it may do, what stops it, what evidence shows the controls work. Assessed by oral defence.

## Certificate in AI Workforce Engineering

Manufacture, govern and retire persistent AI Workers that deliver outcomes rather than assist with tasks. Includes the Forward Deployed Engineer role.

- [W1 Two Modes: Solving Problems and Manufacturing Workers](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/w1-two-modes-solving-and-manufacturing/): The organising distinction of this track. Using an agent to solve today's problem and manufacturing a persistent worker that holds a role are different…
- [W2 The Invariant Architecture: Principal, Delegate, Management Layer](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/w2-invariant-architecture/): Separating durable structure from current product choices — the skill that survives a tooling cycle. Human principal, personal delegate, management layer, and…
- [W3 Engines, Durable Execution and the Event Substrate](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/w3-engines-durability-event-substrate/): A worker that loses its place after a crash is not a worker. Checkpointing, idempotency, at-least-once delivery and the discipline that makes retries safe.
- [W4 System of Record: Postgres, Vectors and Searchable Context](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/w4-system-of-record/): Consolidate by default, specialise deliberately. Where worker state lives, why relational plus vector in one store beats a constellation of specialised ones…
- [W5 Eval-Driven Development for Workers](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/w5-eval-driven-development/): Test-driven development for systems that are not deterministic. The eval is the specification: written first, run in CI, and the gate on deployment.
- [W6 Payment-Enabled Agents and Authority Envelopes](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/w6-payment-enabled-agents/): Agent payment rails, cryptographically signed mandates, and the controls that must exist before software is allowed to spend money. Hands directly into P4 on…
- [W7 The Forward Deployed Engineer: Spec to Production in the Customer's Context](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/w7-forward-deployed-engineer/): The role the AI industry is hiring for and few curricula train: vendor-neutral, embedded with the customer, owning the whole pipeline from an ambiguous…

## Expert Certificate in AI Governance & Assurance

Assure an AI system against regulatory and organisational requirements, and defend that judgement to a board or a regulator.

- [G1 The Regulatory Landscape: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/g1-regulatory-landscape/): What actually applies to a given system, when, and what evidence a regulator will ask for. Taught as applied classification, not as a summary of statutes.
- [G2 Building an AI Management System](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/g2-ai-management-system/): Turning obligations into an operating system: policy, inventory, risk assessment, human oversight and the records that make it auditable.
- [G3 Audits, Evals and Red-Teaming — and the Difference](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/g3-audits-evals-red-teaming/): Three activities routinely conflated, with different questions, methods, independence requirements and outputs. Commissioning the wrong one is how…
- [G4 Assurance Project on a Real System](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/g4-assurance-project/): Perform a full assurance engagement on a real AI system and defend your opinion — including its limitations — to an examining panel.

## Advanced Specialisations

Frontier and adjacent-discipline tracks: quantum computing assessed honestly, actuarial and credit-risk modelling, robotics and embodied AI, and industrial automation. Taken alongside or after P3.

- [Q1 Quantum Computing for AI Practitioners](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/q1-quantum-computing-for-ai/): What quantum computing can and cannot do for machine learning, taught at the level where you can evaluate a vendor claim rather than repeat it. Includes the…
- [Q2 Actuarial and Predictive Risk Models](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/q2-actuarial-and-predictive-risk-models/): The statistical machinery behind credit and insurance risk — survival analysis, GLMs, PD/LGD/EAD and expected loss — and the model-risk discipline that…
- [R1 Robotics and Embodied AI](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/r1-robotics-and-embodied-ai/): What changes when an agent has a body: latency becomes safety, errors become irreversible, and the simulator you trained in is not the world you deployed into.
- [R2 Industrial Automation and Control](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/r2-industrial-automation-and-control/): AI in environments where control theory already works, safety standards already exist, and the burden of proof is on the newcomer. Predictive maintenance…

## Agentic AI for Business Professionals

For professionals who decide rather than code. Judge an agent's output, choose between a general, a custom-built and a pre-built agent, and turn your expertise into skills an agent can follow. Then put agents to work in finance, banking, compliance, legal, operations and HR with the human judgement kept where it belongs. No programming background needed.

- [S1 Thinking Clearly in the AI Era and Agent Foundations](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/s1-thinking-clearly-agent-foundations/): How to work with AI agents without being worked by them. Judge an agent's output, run work on the 10-80-10 rhythm, choose between a general agent, a…
- [S2 Agents in the Office of the CFO, Banking and Compliance](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/s2-agents-cfo-banking-compliance/): Put agents to work in the highest-consequence functions of a firm without giving up the professional's judgement. Build finance skill libraries over a unified…
- [S3 The Agentic Enterprise: Operations, People and Innovation](https://contexai.org/academy/courses/s3-agentic-enterprise-operations-people-innovation/): Take agents beyond finance into the rest of the enterprise. Run a three-way match in accounts payable, design an onboarding agent that knows which steps are…
